name: Azure virtual network peering
short_description: Azure feature that connects two virtual networks so traffic between them flows privately over the Microsoft backbone; global peering connects virtual networks across Azure regions. Peered networks need non-overlapping address spaces, and peering is not transitive.

evidence.quote: That's where VNet Peering comes in. It lets you connect two VNets privately.
Sie müssen keine Peerings erstellen oder Routing-Tabellen konfigurieren.
